idea-plugin.name: WaitLingo
idea-plugin.description:
WaitLingo helps you learn English while working in your IDE.

It shows short English-Turkish word pairs in the status bar and lets you open a lightweight popup with example sentences.

The goal is to turn small waiting moments in the IDE into calm, low-friction vocabulary practice.

  • English-Turkish vocabulary cards
  • Status bar word rotation
  • Two example sentences for every word
  • Lightweight popup UI
  • Works fully offline
  • No telemetry
  • No account required
  • No network request
idea-plugin.change-notes:
WaitLingo 0.1.2

A major learning-experience update focused on calm, context-aware micro-learning while you code.

  • Added persistent learning progress and spaced repetition.
  • Added English-to-Turkish and Turkish-to-English practice directions.
  • Added CEFR, topic, and developer content filters.
  • Added Git, backend, testing, DevOps, database, and frontend phrase packs.
  • Added context-aware vocabulary based on the active source file.
  • Added adaptive rotation for coding, building, debugging, and indexing.
  • Added favorites, word pinning, word of the day, snooze, and hide-for-today actions.
  • Added searchable Tool Window with daily and weekly progress.
  • Added offline pronunciation and personal CSV/JSON vocabulary import.
  • Improved accessibility, compact mode, animation, settings, and documentation.
